competences.description: Reaps the life of the enemy with a deadly scythe. Acquires an additional turn if the enemy dies.
Spreads a plague to all enemies to inflict 2 Continuous Damage for 2 turns. You instantly gain another turn after using the skill.

Meteorites of doomsday fall on to the enemies and the inflicted damage increases with time. Stuns the target for 1 turn and recovers your Attack Bar by 20% each if the enemy is under Continuous Damage.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: If enemy is under Continuous Damage
